fullPassage: A key to engagement and achievement is providing students with relevant texts they will be interested in. My scholarly work and my teaching have been deeply influenced by the work of Rosalie Fink. She interviewed twelve adults who were highly successful in their work, including a physicist, a biochemist, and a company CEO. All of them had dyslexia and had had significant problems with reading throughout their school years. While she expected to find that they had avoided reading and discovered ways to bypass it or compensate with other strategies for learning, she found the opposite. "To my surprise, I found that these dyslexics were enthusiastic readers...they rarely avoided reading. On the contrary, they sought out books." The pattern Fink discovered was that all of her subjects had been passionate in some personal interest. The areas of interest included religion, math, business, science, history, and biography. What mattered was that they read voraciously to find out more.

③ sought out books(책을 찾아 나섰다): '오히려'로 이어지는 긍정적 결론 ←정답
④ ignored their interests(관심사를 무시했다): 뒤 내용(관심사에 열정적)과 모순
det.tip: On the contrary(오히려) 뒤에는 앞의 부정 예상과 반대되는 긍정 행동이 옴

questions.passage: A key to engagement and achievement is providing students with relevant texts they ①<u>will</u> be interested in. My scholarly work and my teaching have been deeply influenced by the work of Rosalie Fink. She interviewed twelve adults who were highly successful in their work, including a physicist, a biochemist, and a company CEO. All of ②<u>them</u> had dyslexia and had had significant problems with reading throughout their school years. While she expected to find that they had avoided reading and discovered ways to bypass it or compensate with other strategies ③<u>for</u> learning, she found the opposite. "To my surprise, I found that these dyslexics were enthusiastic readers...they rarely avoided reading. On the contrary, they sought out books." The pattern Fink discovered was that all of her subjects had been passionate in some personal interest. The areas of interest included religion, math, business, science, history, and biography. What mattered was that they ④<u>reading</u> voraciously to find out more.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ reading → read: 주어 they의 본동사 자리이므로 정형동사(과거형 read)가 필요
det.analysis:
① will: 'texts they will be interested in' 조동사 — 정상
② them: 전치사 of의 목적어 'All of them' 목적격 — 정상
③ for: 'strategies for learning' 전치사 — 정상
④ reading → read: 'they ___ voraciously'는 주어 they의 본동사 자리라 정형동사 read(과거형)가 필요, reading(-ing형)은 불가 ←정답
det.tip: 문장의 본동사는 정형동사(read), -ing형(reading)은 불가

det.korean: all of her subjects had been passionate (그녀의 모든 대상자들은 열정적이었다)
det.analysis:
all of her subjects(그녀의 모든 대상자들) + had been(과거완료) + passionate(열정적인).

만드는 순서: 주어 'all of her subjects'(all of + 소유격 + 명사) → 과거완료 had been → 보어 형용사 passionate.

det.tip: all of + 소유격 + 명사 = ~의 모든 …. had been + 형용사 = ~했었다
